profile.headline: Software Engineer III at Farmers Insurance

positions.title: Freelance Software Developer
positions.description:
● Developed the multichannel real-time inventory management software. 
● Developed a warehouse management system web app for accurate picking, packing, and shipping of orders. 
● Automated shipping tasks and decisions to increase efficiency.

positions.title: Desktop Technician Summer Intern
positions.description:
● Performed the desktop support under direct supervision to ensure that the hardware, application, and network works efficiently
● Configured the computer security measures to minimize the risk of failure and loss of data.
● Troubleshoot the email and internet connectivity issues

projects.title: San Diego Traffic Analysis
projects.description:
Critically analyzed the traffic volumes street by street, highway by highway of past 5 years using
Python libraries.
Visualized and processed the data using Pandas, NumPy, gmplot, Google maps, matplotlib.
Proposed new transit lines based on the analysis and current road work projects.

projects.title: Promisecuous (Encrypted social network) Senior Class Project
projects.description:
Worked with team to developed AngularJS based social network that has similar functionality like Facebook but also has the end to end encryption for data.
The progressive web application developed using agile methodology and software engineering skills
